name: lira
subject: Lira, a teenage lantern pilgrim girl, heroine of a dark-fantasy side-scrolling action game
identity: a tall, slender girl of about seventeen with a determined, calm expression and sharp amber (honey-gold) eyes; very long silver-white hair tied in a high ponytail that sweeps behind her, short side bangs; pale skin. She wears a short deep-navy hooded travelling cape (hood down) fastened at the collarbone with a small brass clasp, a fitted cream and beige travelling tunic with a brown leather belt carrying a small glass oil flask and a paper charm talisman, dark brown fitted trousers and knee-high dark brown boots. No armour, no helmet, no metal plates. In her right hand she holds a plain straight one-handed steel sword pointing down and slightly forward; from her left hand hangs an old-fashioned iron and glass lantern on a short chain, glowing warm amber inside. Standing in a ready stance, knees slightly bent.
